user.title: Address
user.description: As written on simbio.si, e.g. Ljubljanska cesta 1 A.

name.title: Waste types, name and phones
name.description: Choose the waste types and the device name. Choose the phones that get reminders. Leave the phones empty to turn reminders off. You can change types, times and events later in the options.

data_description.notify_targets: Bin Day sends reminders to these phones. Leave this empty to turn reminders off.

error.no_match: Simbio does not know this address.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Simbio. Try again later.
error.no_types: Choose at least one waste type.

abort.already_configured: This address is already set up.

address_not_found.title: Simbio no longer knows the address {address}
address_not_found.description: Remove Bin Day and add it again with the new address.

type.title: {type}
type.description: Name, icon and colour for {type}. Use a colour like #00a136. The interval must be 7 to 35 days.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: You can also turn each reminder on or off with its switch on the device.

data_description.notify_targets: Leave empty to send no notifications. Bin Day then fires only the bin_day_reminder event.

error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number from 7 to 35, or leave it empty.
